question: Which classes of semi-divine beings are included in the scope of this yogic vision?
premises: Yakshas, Nagas, and Vidyadharas are named
They are addressed in relation to the beloved
inference: The vision includes Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakshas, Nagas, and Vidyadharas.
plain_english: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakshas, Nagas, and Vidyadharas, O beloved.
